semanticReview.method: R33 source follow-up: reopened the article and prior review; consulted free institutional material; compared claims with locatable pages/sections; partial support is not extended to unsupported claims.
findings: El cuadro oficial respalda parte de las formas pasadas, pero no todas las generalizaciones sobre estilo llano, usos subordinados/prenominales y equivalencias aspectuales del artículo.

Irodori, Grammar notes, PDF pp. 28–29, Lesson 9 “How to make the plain style”: table maps V-ました to V-た and shows 読みました → 読んだ; it also separates past negative forms. This supports the basic plain/past contrast, not the full paradigms, prenominal/subordinate uses, or aspectual translations in the article.
limitations: No se creó Evidence canónica ni se modificó el artículo. El estado pendiente no equivale a validación ni a VERIFIED.
The official table supports part of the content; each alternation and discourse/aspect claim still lacks a claim-level locator.
No canonical Evidence was created and assessEntry did not pass; article unchanged and status not promoted to VERIFIED.
